pre_command: osascript -e 'tell application "Pages" to quit without saving' && osascript -e 'tell application "Numbers" to quit without saving' && osascript -e 'tell application "Keynote" to quit without saving' && osascript -e 'tell application "Keynote" to activate' && sleep 5 && osascript -e 'tell application "Keynote" to make new document with properties {document theme:theme "Dynamic Waves Light"}'
instruction: I'm making a paper presentation about this article: https://neurips.cc/virtual/2024/poster/94798. I've chosen a Keynote template. Now, I need your help copying the title into the slide's title and copying the authors into the subtitle of the slide.
evaluator: osascript -e 'tell application "Keynote" to get the object text of the default title item of the current slide of the front document' | grep -q "Can Simple Averaging Defeat Modern Watermarks?" && osascript -e 'tell application "Keynote" to get the object text of the default body item of the current slide of the front document' | grep "Pei Yang" | grep "Hai Ci" | grep "Yiren Song" | grep -q "Mike Zheng Shou" && echo "True" || echo "False"
